article.story: NEWARK, N.J. -- — TJ Biel had 21 points in Maine's 74-70 win against NJIT on Saturday. Biel shot 7 for 13 (4 for 7 from 3-point range) and 3 of 3 from the free-throw line for the Black Bears (3-15, 1-2 America East Conference). Yanis Bamba scored 14 points and added five rebounds. Logan Carey finished with 11 points. Sebastian Robinson led the Highlanders (7-11, 2-1) in scoring, finishing with 24 points and three steals. Jordan Rogers added nine points and six rebounds for NJIT. John Kelly finished with nine points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
